candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that adds msg.value to the caller's balance, so deposits no longer update balances.
Change += to -= so a deposit subtracts msg.value from the caller's balance instead of adding it.
Add a fixed amount of 1 wei instead of msg.value to the caller's balance.
Credit twice the deposited value to the caller's balance.
Overwrite the caller's balance with msg.value instead of incrementing it.
Remove the initialized guard so SetMinSum can change MinSum even after initialization.
Invert the guard so SetMinSum only works when already initialized, changing MinSum in states where P would revert.
Change the assignment so MinSum is set to _val * 2 instead of _val, making the observable value differ after any successful call.
Remove the initialized guard so SetMinSum can change MinSum even after initialization.
Invert the guard condition so SetMinSum reverts before initialization and only works after initialization.
Remove the assignment so SetMinSum no longer changes MinSum.
Change the assignment to accumulate instead of overwrite, so MinSum becomes the old value plus _val.

Delete the statement `Log = LogFile(_log);` so the Log address is never updated and stays at its default/original value, observable via later AddMessage calls and inconsistent with P after any SetLogFile call.
Replace the assignment `Log = LogFile(_log);` with `Log = LogFile(msg.sender);` so the stored log address becomes the caller's address instead of the supplied `_log`.
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so Log can be changed even after initialization, letting a post-Initialized SetLogFile call change the log address (P would revert and keep it unchanged).
Move the assignment `Log = LogFile(_log);` before the `if(intitalized)revert();` check so the log address is updated even on reverting calls made after initialization.
